properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 10 at 7:12PM CDT until September 10 at 10:00PM CDT by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
properties.description:
FFWMAF

The National Weather Service in Midland/Odessa has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Pecos County in southwestern Texas...

* Until 1000 PM CDT.

* At 712 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated slow moving thunderstorms
producing heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5
inches of rain have quickly fallen. Additional heavy rainfall
amounts up to around 1 inch will be possible. Flash flooding is
ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Central Pecos County, including U.S. Highway
285 southeast of Fort Stockton.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 10:17AM EDT until September 13 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Florida...

Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US 301 affecting Hillsborough
County.

Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 affecting Manatee County.

.Rising water levels are expected over the next several days along
the Alafia River At Lithia and Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 due
to recent heavy rainfall. The Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US
301 and Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 are no longer
forecast to reach Minor Flood Stage.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Alafia River at Lithia .

* WHEN...From this evening to late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, River Drive and Squirrel Run Way downstream
of County Road 640 are completely covered by water. One home begins
to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 AM EDT Thursday the stage was 10.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 13.3 feet early Saturday
morning. It will then fall below flood stage late Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 13.3
feet on 08/26/1945.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this morning at 1130 AM EDT.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 10 at 8:05PM CDT until September 10 at 8:30PM CDT by NWS Lubbock TX
properties.description:
At 805 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Claytonville,
or 15 miles southwest of Silverton, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Tennis ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
South Plains and Claytonville.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 10 at 7:00PM CDT until September 10 at 9:15PM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
properties.description:
At 700 PM CDT, trained weather spotters reported thunderstorms
producing heavy rain in Flooding reported in Lake Tanglewood. .
Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall
rate is 1 to 3 inches in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to
2 inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Trained spotters reported.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Lake Tanglewood and Palo Duro Canyon.

The Palo Duro Canyon Rim picked up about a half an inch in 10 minutes
and the floor recently picked up an inch in just 15 minutes.  Low
lying areas need to take caution as these rain rates could lead to
more significant flooding conditions in the Palo Duro Canyon area.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 10 at 8:12PM CDT until September 10 at 8:45PM CDT by NWS Paducah KY
properties.description:
At 812 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
over Milltown to 6 miles east of Gatewood, or along a line from 11
miles west of Poplar Bluff to 10 miles southwest of Doniphan, moving
east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Doniphan, Budapest, Gatewood, Fairdealing and Briar.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. These storms are capable of producing damaging winds and
large hail.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can
hear thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.
